implemented: Simulates explicit rejected opportunities from executable bid/ask quotes and displayed size only.
Shares quote depth across orders and enforces each BUY intent's virtual cash budget.
Models FIFO entry/exit fills, partial/no fills, unresolved close quantities, and explicit costs.
Persists immutable shadow book outputs in a hash-chained journal.
Hard labels all results EXPLORATORY_SHADOW, never observed cash P&L, and never promotion-eligible; controls do not bypass this gate.
blockers: No live quote journal or rejection stream integration; inputs remain caller-supplied.
No shared multi-strategy portfolio cash or margin accounting in this shadow book.
No registered matched control-book integration; supplied control IDs are recorded but not independently verified.
